author: Ari Koslow
title: Quentin Grimes linked to Lakers
desc: Quentin Grimes is emerging as a top free agent target for the Lakers.
impact: The Lakers have plenty of money opened up with LeBron James not returning. They'll be looking to add more shooting around Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dennis Schroder could be traded
desc: The Cavs have reportedly held trade conversations regarding Dennis Schroder.
impact: Schroder and Max Strus both could potentially be traded as Cleveland looks to free up space to try to bring back LeBron James.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Strus could be traded
desc: The Cavs have reportedly held trade conversations regarding Max Strus.
impact: Strus and Dennis Schroder both could potentially be traded as Cleveland looks to free up space to try to bring back LeBron James.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Precious Achiuwa signs two-year deal with Kings
desc: Precious Achiuwa has agreed on terms to re-sign with the Sacramento Kings on a two-year, $11.5 million deal.
impact: Achiuwa returns to Sacramento in a depth role in the front court.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Kawhi Leonard: Clippers nearing deal with Raptors
desc: Kawhi Leonard is increasingly likely to be headed back to the Raptors, as the teams are nearing a deal that would send Leonard to Toronto for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dock, two firsts, a first round swap, and two seconds round picks.
impact: A Kawhi reunion with Toronto seems inevitable no. Though it's a vastly different team now than it was during his title run with them, his ability on both sides of the floor even at his age paired with the talent Toronto has acquired since then should put them in the running as one of the best teams in the Eastern Conference.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Moses Moody could be traded
desc: The Warriors are expected to explore trade avenues for 24-year-old wing Moses Moody.
impact: Golden State is looking to gain additional cap flexibility. Moody, who is still recovering from a season-ending knee injury, has two years remaining on his contract, including a $12.5M salary for the upcoming season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kris Dunn has contract fully guaranteed by Clippers
desc: The Los Angeles Clippers will fully guarantee Kris Dunn's $5.7 million salary for the 2026-27 season.
impact: Dunn will figure to remain in a reserve role for the Clippers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Walker Kessler confirmed to meet with Lakers
desc: The Los Angeles Lakers are set to meet with restricted free agent center Walker Kessler.
impact: Kessler is expected to meet with three teams. The Lakers are officially one of them after losing LeBron James.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyson Etienne to become unrestricted free agent
desc: The Brooklyn Nets did not tender a qualifying offer to Tyson Etienne.
impact: Etienne is expected to draw interest as an unrestricted free agent.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jock Landale to return to Hawks on one-year deal
desc: Jock Landale intends to sign a one-year, $14 million deal to return to the Atlanta Hawks.
impact: Landale was traded to Atlanta last season where he averaged 10.6 points and 5.7 rebounds. He'll figure to remain in a similar role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bronny James contract becomes fully guaranteed
desc: Bronny James' contract with the Los Angeles Lakers became fully guaranteed for $2.3 million on Monday.
impact: Bronny will no longer be playing with LeBron, who announced Tuesday that he is leaving the team. He'll remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Marcus Sasser linked to Mavericks in trade talks
desc: The Mavericks have emerged a leading suitor to acquire Detroit's Marcus Sasser in a trade.
impact: This will be a situation to continue to monitor. Dallas continues to look to build up its depth in the back court.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Simone Fontecchio signs one-year deal with Heat
desc: Simone Fontecchio intends to sign a one-year deal to return to the Miami Heat.
impact: Fontecchio averaged 8.5 points on 37.5 percent three-point shooting last season. He'll remain in a reserve role.

author: Garrett Ball
title: LeBron James informs Lakers he will play elsewhere in 2026-27 season
desc: LeBron James has informed the Los Angeles Lakers that he intends to play elsewhere this upcoming 2026-27 season and to move on without him.
impact: This is a big leap forward for the LeBron to the Warriors rumors, which is admittedly still up in the air. However, it does provide closure to the LeBron-Lakers era, as well as the LeBron-Luka duo. It's now a waiting game as to see who will get James next and what their playoff and title aspirations might be.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Robert Williams III signing 3-year, $44 million deal with Blazers
desc: Robert Williams III has agreed to a 3-year, $44 million deal with the Portland Trailblazers.
impact: Time Lord will return to a Blazers team that recently added Ja Morant and should get Damian Lillard back this upcoming season. Portland isn't quite among the top of the Western Conference, but with their youth, potential stars, and veteran playmakers, they appear to be on an upward trajectory.
